item.title: Thunderstorm Advisory No. 1 #VISPRSD
item.description:
Thunderstorm Advisory No. 1 #VISPRSD
Issued at 12:10 AM 28 November 2026

Moderate to Heavy rainshowers with lightning and strong winds are expected over #Aklan(Malay, Buruanga, Balete, Banga, Numancia, Kalibo, Lezo, NewWashington), #Antique(Libertad, Sebaste, Culasi, Barbaza, Tibiao, LauaAn), #Leyte(Tanauan, Julita, Tabontabon, Burauen, LaPaz, Mayorga, Macarthur, Javier, Abuyog), #SouthernLeyte(Libagon, Liloan), #EasternSamar(Maydolong and Balangkayan) within the next 30 minutes to an hour.

The above conditions are being experienced in #Capiz(Jamindan, Tapaz), #Aklan(Libacao, Madalag, Tangalan, Ibajay, Makato, Altavas, Batan, Nabas, Malinao), #Antique(Pandan), #Iloilo(Lambunao), #Leyte(Tolosa, Dulag, Albuera), #SouthernLeyte(SaintBernard, Hinunangan and SanJuan) which may persist within 1 to 2 hours and may affect nearby areas.

All are advised to take precautionary measures against the impacts associated with these hazards which include flash floods and landslides. Keep monitoring for updates.
